listing.name: Castlevania: Harmony of Despair — HarmonyRecomp (Dojutsu)
listing.summary: Upstream documents packages and Play/Join controls. Full-campaign, platform and network compatibility remain unknown. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Castlevania: Harmony of Despair Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Base title 58410A7A/media 6480C08F/v0.0.1.4 and mandatory TU 2 to 0.0.2.4; DLC optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the package for your platform and follow upstream instructions to import your own base game and mandatory title update 2. DLC is optional. iPhone and iPad also need local Xcode preparation.

warnings: Upstream documents packages and Play/Join controls. Full-campaign, platform and network compatibility remain unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
